title: Refund - within 14 days
body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for reaching out. Your charge on {{charge_date}} is within our 14-day refund window, so I've requested a full refund to your original payment method. It usually appears in 5-10 business days.

title: Send invoice or receipt copy
body: Hi {{first_name}}, you can download every invoice and receipt under Settings > Billing > History. I've also attached the one you asked for.

title: Password reset / lockout
body: Hi {{first_name}}, after too many attempts accounts lock for 30 minutes and then unlock on their own. If the reset email doesn't arrive, please allow-list no-reply@quillfern.example.com and try again.

title: Calendar resync steps
body: Hi {{first_name}}, let's get your calendar syncing again: 1) disconnect and reconnect under Settings > Integrations, 2) re-authorize each affected staff member, 3) check their calendar time zone matches your business time zone. Changes can take up to 10 minutes.

title: Known issue - SMS reminders
body: Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for flagging this. We're seeing delays with SMS reminders for some carriers right now. Reminders are queued and will go out once the carrier recovers; you can follow updates at status.quillfern.example.com.

title: Cancellation confirmation
body: Hi {{first_name}}, I'm sorry to see you go. The account owner can cancel under Settings > Billing > Cancel plan, and service continues until {{period_end}}. Your data stays available for export for 30 days after that.
